title: REM: The Manifestation of Hidden Forces

content.text:
## R.E.M

_The Manifestation of Hidden Forces_

**Anna R Czímer**

The book "R.E.M" will always hold a special place in my heart as the very first book cover to feature my art, and with my name right along the spine on the back of the book. Anna sent me this photo soon after publication, a photo that still makes me smile to this very day. It features my award-winning "[Chaos Clock](chaos-clock)" fractal prominently on the cover, a trend that would continue on to the second book in the series -- "R.E.M 2."

It was only ever published in Hungarian, but with the advances in translation, I hope to one day read it myself. Even better, I really need to export myself one of these years to Hungary. Truly... it's overdue!

### Extended Exploration

While my "[Chaos Clock](chaos-clock)" from the book's cover is my most famous symbol fractal, my best-selling symbol fractal is "[Bangles del Aguila](bangles-del-aguila)" .. and with other inspiring ones in my [pop art fractals](other-pop-art). You can see many of my designs [here as game art, album art, and book covers](cover-art-others).
